name: ProPerAgent raises proactive assistance without retraining
title: ProPerAgent raises proactive assistance without retraining
summary: ProPerAgent retrieves personal memories from objects in view, then a separate check decides whether anything is worth saying now. Accuracy rises from at most 15% for standard memory baselines to 38% with no weight change. Removing that filter drops accuracy from 37.3% to 24.0%. Untrained Qwen3.8-27B reaches 37.5%, and RL on the same model reaches 42.4%.

appearances.title: ProPerAgent harness times proactive help
appearances.summary: Meta's ProPerAgent harness raises proactive-assistant accuracy from at most 15% with standard memory baselines to 38% without changing the model weights, by checking whether a retrieved memory justifies speaking. With Qwen3.8-27B it reaches 37.5% before training and 42.4% after reinforcement learning that penalizes premature and repeated interruptions.
